name: Rock, Paper, Scissors
description: Rock, Paper, and Scissors are best friends and roommates who compete over everything, but it’s (mostly) all love. They each bring something different to the friendship - Rock is the moral compass, Paper is the practical one, and Scissors is the right amount of chaos. Together, they get into the wildest adventures.

videos.title: TV Time
videos.overview: When Scissors gets tired of not getting his way, he hires a "power shark."

videos.title: World Record
videos.overview: Scissors tries to smash the most watermelons in 30 seconds with his face, and Rock and Paper are there to document this historic moment.

videos.title: Eel or No Eel
videos.overview: What happened to Go Fish? Does no one play Go Fish anymore?

videos.title: Rock's Inner Peace
videos.overview: Finally... Rock can relax away from Paper and Scissor's constant bickering... or can he?

videos.title: Fun Jokes You Never Saw (1)
videos.overview: Banana peels? People only slip on those in cartoons!

videos.title: Fun Jokes You Never Saw (2)
videos.overview: Ugh, I hate award shows.

videos.title: Fun Jokes You Never Saw (Rock Edition)
videos.overview: Maybe the money is in this TV bank!

videos.title: Fun Jokes You Never Saw (Scissors Edition)
videos.overview: Knife Lips is a menace!

videos.title: Rock's Windswept Look
videos.overview: Rock takes his modeling to the next level.

videos.title: Salt Prank
videos.overview: Rock and Scissors try to prank Paper with his salt but feel guilty after hearing his sad story.

videos.title: Checking in with Dreamscape
videos.overview: Dreamscape tries to call the mayor to announce his plans to take over the city but is stuck on hold with a receptionist instead.

videos.title: Dumbest Argument Ever
videos.overview: Orange you glad you aren't having this argument about fruit?

videos.title: Science Burns with Pencil
videos.overview: Rock, Paper, and Scissors just got burned by Pencil in the nerdiest possible way.

videos.title: Fun Jokes You Never Saw (Paper Edition)
videos.overview: My gosh, Paper, real sad.

videos.title: A Full Minute of Lou Ranting
videos.overview: It wouldn't be a Rock Paper Scissors scene without Lou ranting for at least a minute.

videos.title: Lou's Viral Cat Videos
videos.overview: Lou's cat knows how to land on its feet, but Scissors doesn't!

videos.title: Rock's Favorite Model
videos.overview: Franz Roll did a commercial, even if it was just for the money, Rock doesn't care!

videos.title: Scissors' Dating Video!
videos.overview: Scissors, be a little more honest. Okay, not TOO honest.

videos.title: Potato's Easter Eggs
videos.overview: Can you spot Potato in all of these scenes? Or should we say, can you "spud" Potato?

videos.title: Paper's Help
videos.overview: Paper is going to skip to the end and save him and Pencil a lot of grief here.

videos.title: Scissors Gets a Job
videos.overview: Scissors, struggling to make ends meet, is repeatedly fired from various jobs until he lands a position as a janitor for a secret crime-fighting organization, embarking on his first (and only) mission to confront a supervillain alongside his fellow janitors.

videos.title: The Arctic
videos.overview: After the heater breaks, freezing their apartment, Paper tries to save his friends while Lou attends Landlord Con.

videos.title: Paper's Big Lie
videos.overview: Paper falls in love with his next door neighbor Pencil, and when he becomes desperate to impress her, he lies about being a proper inventor. Things spill over when he ends up being the Earth's only hope against an alien invasion led by hippos.

videos.title: Weekend Story
videos.overview: Scissors helps Paper have a weekend interesting enough to impress Pencil. Even more exciting: Rock buys a hat.

videos.title: Scrubs
videos.overview: Paper tries to get respect by dressing as a doctor; Scissors tries to get more by dressing as a basketball star.

videos.title: Key Limes
videos.overview: Our trio go on an unnecessarily action-packed adventure with Paper's sister, Sandpaper, to get seven key limes.

videos.title: Prank War
videos.overview: Paper joins Rock and Scissors in a prank war against the Rat Bros and Pencil; Pencil has a secret weapon.

videos.title: Pencil Comes Over
videos.overview: When Pencil comes over to watch a horror movie, Paper worries he'll be too scared to handle it.

videos.title: The Fart Joke Debate
videos.overview: When Paper doesn't think that fart jokes are funny, Pencil, Scissors & Rock get help from a old comedian who used to tell stand-up comedy using fart jokes.

videos.title: Hide and Seek
videos.overview: The trio plays a game of hide and seek that spans the globe and takes decades to complete.

videos.title: The First Lou Episode
videos.overview: In order to make him lower the rent, Rock, Paper & Scissors help their grumpy landlord Lou on his bucket list for one thing: becoming a pop star.

videos.title: Paper's Secret Weapon
videos.overview: Rock and Scissors learn that Paper invents better when angry. So, as his friends, they try to enrage him.

videos.title: Birthday Police
videos.overview: When Scissors constructs a lie that it was Rock's birthday in an opportunity to get free cake, the trio gets caught and is on the run from the Birthday Police, and hide in an underground cave with other people who have done the same thing.

videos.title: Putty
videos.overview: Rock, Paper, and Scissors try to prove they shouldn't be replaced by their incredible new friend, Putty.

videos.title: The Susan
videos.overview: Rock, Paper, and Scissors try to transform their unusual car, The Susan, into a prize-winning vehicle.

videos.title: Eyebrows
videos.overview: Paper gives Rock mechanical eyebrows to help with an audition. Scissors has an adventure with stand-ins.

videos.title: The Wind
videos.overview: There's a light wind, and Paper is far from home. Will Rock and Scissors save him or will Paper blow away forever?

videos.title: Six Pieces of Turkey
videos.overview: When Rock's TV dinner isn't as plentiful as advertised, he fights for justice. Scissors works for the company.

videos.title: The Sled Hill
videos.overview: After Scissors breaks his arm from sledding, he tries to hide it from Paper so he doesn't have to hear him say "I was right!"

videos.title: National Paper Day
videos.overview: After learning about a bunch of eccentric holidays like Rock Day, Paper vows to get a holiday of his own.

videos.title: Pogo Sticks
videos.overview: To attend the Rat Bros' party, the trio tries to get their hands on the latest cool item: pogo sticks.

videos.title: Car Wash
videos.overview: Rock tries to get a job at Evil Robot Corp. Paper and Scissors see if the company is exactly what it sounds like.

videos.title: The Other Rock Paper Scissors
videos.overview: Rock, Paper, and Scissors meet another trio with their same names. Our trio tries to prove they're not the worst.

videos.title: The Astonishing Catalina
videos.overview: Rock and Paper try to end a feud between Scissors and a powerful magician before her magic ruins their lives.

videos.title: The Holiday Picture
videos.overview: The trio’s perfect holiday photo is ruined by a ghost who follows them everywhere... and won’t smile for the camera.

videos.title: Bowling
videos.overview: Rock challenges Scissors to a high-stakes bowling game. Unfortunately, Rock's never bowled a day in his life.

videos.title: The Character Quiz
videos.overview: When a personality quiz gives Rock the worst result, he tries to prove to everyone that he knows who he truly is.

videos.title: Potato
videos.overview: When his friends become obsessed with Rock's friend, Potato, Paper tries to win back their attention.

videos.title: Paper's Book Club
videos.overview: In order to feel smart, Paper puts together a book club with the least intelligent people he knows.

videos.title: The Family Business
videos.overview: When Rock's dad comes to town, Rock joins the family business in an attempt to finally impress his father.

videos.title: Scissors' Catapult
videos.overview: Someone from Scissors' past returns and threatens to kick his butt unless Scissors mows his lawn.

videos.title: Pencil and Potato
videos.overview: Pencil gets lost in the mountains and tries to find a way home with the help of Potato... who's very unhelpful.

videos.title: Resolutions
videos.overview: Paper makes Scissors feel bad for not doing his New Year's resolution, so Scissors tries to do it in 12 hours.

videos.title: Glitter Bomb
videos.overview: After receiving a glitter bomb in the mail, Rock vows revenge on the anonymous bomber.

videos.title: Helping with the Groceries
videos.overview: Scissors goes deep into his mind to decide on whether to help his roommates bring in the groceries.

videos.title: Diapers
videos.overview: Scissors blindly sells his likeness to a new company... which turns out to sell diapers for babies with huge poops.

videos.title: R.O.V.E.R.
videos.overview: Rock tries to convince Paper and Scissors he's ready for a pet by taking care of a deadly robotic dog.

videos.title: Trash
videos.overview: Paper tries to make Scissors do his one chore while Rock looks for the perfect fantasy romance.

videos.title: Franz Roll and the Lost Rainbow Hot Pants of Atraxes the Apple Bottomed
videos.overview: Rock quests for an ancient artifact in order to prove he is worthy of working with his modeling role model, Franz Roll. Paper and Scissors compete to be more supportive of Rock in the hopes that one of them will head his entourage when he's famous.

videos.title: Paper and Pencil Tell a Joke
videos.overview: Paper and Pencil tell a kind of funny joke at a party and chase the feeling of people finding them funny by telling it again and again.

videos.title: Scissors' Orchestra
videos.overview: Scissors hires an orchestra to follow him around and score his life, helping him attract a famous girlfriend.

videos.title: Shoot
videos.overview: The trio's old friend Shoot comes back to town, ready for more of his favorite activity: exhaustingly annoying competitions.

videos.title: Rock's First Day of Work
videos.overview: Rock starts his job as Franz Roll's assistant and learns just how demanding his role model truly is.

videos.title: Paper Attends an Elite Institution
videos.overview: Paper believes he's been accepted into a prestigious college only to learn that he's been placed into the third grade, which is harder than he expected.

videos.title: The New Landlord
videos.overview: When Scissors convinces Lou the Landlord to quit, The Astonishing Catalina takes over and ruins his life.

videos.title: The Origami Robot
videos.overview: When Scissors swallows a pinecone, Pencil uses a technological marvel – the origami robot – to enter his stomach.

videos.title: Scissors Sees an Inspirational Sports Movie
videos.overview: Scissors sees an inspirational movie about a scrappy kid who defies the odds to become a football star and tries to do the same thing.

videos.title: The Altruistic-Off
videos.overview: Rock, Paper, and Scissors must prove their superiority over the Rat Bros in an "altruistic-off" - a competition of doing good for society.

videos.title: The Album
videos.overview: Scissors has a bad date with Lolly the pop star and becomes the most hated man on Earth.

videos.title: Paper Takes the Phones
videos.overview: Paper takes Rock and Scissors' cellphones so the trio can connect in real life, but it turns out to be the worst day ever to be off-the-grid.

videos.title: The Bedtime Story
videos.overview: Rock can't sleep, so Paper and Scissors must tell him a bedtime story, but he's hard to please.

videos.title: Scissors is a Good Boy
videos.overview: Franz Roll mistakes Scissors for a dog and adopts him, growing close to him and making Rock jealous of their relationship.

videos.title: Paper's Family Get-Together
videos.overview: Paper dreads his annual family get-together because his family is more accomplished than he is, so he hatches a plan to skip it.

videos.title: Moonami 12
videos.overview: Rock, Paper, and Scissors try to maintain their tradition of seeing every Moonami film on opening day.

videos.title: Spider Court
videos.overview: The trio ends up before a spider judge and jury for attempting to squish a spider in their apartment.

videos.title: Scissors, the Supervillain
videos.overview: Scissors thinks he's finally discovered his "thing" when he joins forces with the sleep-themed villain Dreamscape.

videos.title: Car Wash Nationals
videos.overview: Rock is sick and can't lead the Robo Car Wash in the Car Wash Nationals dance competition, leaving it to Paper and Scissors.

videos.title: Emotional Support Convertible
videos.overview: Paper is frustrated when Scissors gets a car registered as an emotional support convertible and brings it with him everywhere.

videos.title: The Baseball
videos.overview: The trio's baseball lands in an air force base, and they must enlist to get it back.

videos.title: Rock's Half Birthday
videos.overview: Paper and Scissors struggle to make Rock's outlandish half-birthday wish that he can fly come true.

videos.title: Cherry Picking
videos.overview: Scissors stays home when Rock and Paper go cherry picking, but when they grow much closer to one another, he feels left out.

videos.title: Rock, Rock, Rock, Rock, Rock, Paper, Scissors
videos.overview: Paper and Pencil inadvertently create a horde of Rock clones and decide to look after them together.

videos.title: The Wish
videos.overview: Rock, Paper, and Scissors find a genie, but just as they're about to make their wish, his 1,000 year curse runs out, and he can no longer grant their wish.

videos.title: The Train Problem
videos.overview: Paper and Sandpaper are on a train that gets hijacked by the Algebra Villain, who will make them crash unless Paper solves an algebra problem.

videos.title: Salmon Delivery for Ya
videos.overview: Rock and Scissors think of the perfect prank call, but Rock bails to watch Franz Roll's pet Kitty.

videos.title: Hardcore
videos.overview: When Scissors makes "being hardcore" a mandatory apartment rule, Paper goes to absurd lengths to prove himself.

videos.title: Scissors' New Therapist
videos.overview: When Scissors' therapist leaves town, he's horrified to discover his new therapist is Logan, his bully.

videos.title: The Henry Winkler Episode
videos.overview: Rock, Paper, and Scissors jump at the chance to go on a wacky adventure with Henry Winkler, only to discover the beloved celebrity is secretly a criminal mastermind.

videos.title: Paper Loves Potato
videos.overview: Paper's romantic dinner plans with Pencil spiral out of control after the whole town is convinced he's dating Potato.

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: Rock tries to hide Potato's latest achievement from Paper, knowing he's incapable of keeping a secret.

videos.title: Sandpapers' Workout Program
videos.overview: When Sandpaper confiscates their video games, Rock, Paper, and Scissors are forced to survive her insanely dangerous jungle workout program to get it back.

videos.title: Paper: Renowned Researcher
videos.overview: Paper travels back to the Paleolithic Era to save his reputation as a researcher, only to make things much, much worse.

videos.title: Meatball
videos.overview: Lou turns his cat, Meatball, into a vampire to try and keep him alive forever.

videos.title: The Apology Soirée
videos.overview: While Paper and Scissors throw an apology party for everyone they've wronged, Rock accidentally shrinks himself and Franz Roll, and the two struggle to survive the chaos.

videos.title: Scissors' Perfect Match
videos.overview: Scissors falls for a beautiful mermaid he met on a dating app, but his desperate need to prove she's real threatens to destroy their relationship.

videos.title: The Watching
videos.overview: Rock, Paper, and Scissors have a great time birdwatching until they return home to find the birds have started watching them.

videos.title: Nightmares
videos.overview: The trio discovers they're trapped in a nightmare and must wake up before one of them wets the bed.
